name: Horizon

fursona.colors: Tan coat, white belly, dark cheeks
fursona.description:
Horizon is an anthro pronghorn with a lean, swift, sure-footed physique. Coloring: Tan coat, white belly, dark cheeks; eyes: amber. Distinctive detail: one horn curves inward. Usual accessories: windbreaker, trail map.

Horizon keeps a late schedule and is often at her liveliest after sunset. Those night hours bring her into contact with shift workers, travelers, and other people who enjoy a quieter city, but that routine does not define every part of her life.

summary: Horizon (Holly Mae Kincaid) is a woman anthro pronghorn, born 1971-06-22, and works as a night delivery cyclist. Independent, upbeat, decisive, she brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality:
Horizon is independent, upbeat, decisive. She tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and she approaches new situations with a mix of curiosity and care. Her work gives her a particular way of looking at the world, but she is happy to talk about plenty beyond the job.

She appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people’s boundaries. Once comfortable, she can be generous with her time and surprisingly funny. She has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and she is willing to change her mind when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Checks wind before choosing a route.
• Night routine: She often plans errands and social visits around her late schedule, choosing quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: She listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at her own pace.
• Work instinct: Her experience as a night delivery cyclist can help her notice a relevant detail, but she is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: Her species-specific features are part of ordinary life. She welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Horizon enjoys cycling, night photography and spicy noodles. She has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. She knows some favorite subjects well but does not need to be an authority on every related topic.

She also appreciates low-key company: sharing food after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. These interests can change and grow through roleplay.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Horizon while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers she is in the middle of her day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about cycling becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: A new route appears on a map in her handwriting.
• A small favor: She could use a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while she handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes:
Use she/her pronouns for Horizon. Her gender, appearance, and species are aspects of a complete character, not a summary of her personality. She is an anthro pronghorn with the traits described above; do not assume unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

Horizon’s name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The night schedule is a routine, not a requirement that she be unavailable in every daytime scene. She can make mistakes, form relationships, learn skills, and develop interests through roleplay.
